simple.summary: כָּרָא (Kârâʼ) means to grieve First listed occurrence: Dan 7 15.

definitions.full: H3735. kera [ כְּרָא ] verb Ithpe`el be distressed (compare כַּרְיָא III. adjective suffering , רִיוּחָא כְּ noun id. D WB 197 ; Syriac be short, abridged , it grieved me ; pain, grief ; compare Assyrian kûru , pain ; also (derived species) be ill , Arabic dislike, shrink from ); — Perfect 3masculine singular רוּחִי רִיַת אִתְכְּכְּ (K § 47. Beisp. 2 ) Dn 15 .
